principal_findings: All three fixed saved-head variants remain154/168 complete IR on both raw and joint training routes; no descriptive155 threshold crossing.

Both fixed conditions cases retain the gold full span at rank2 or3 inside the actual full-span top8 for every donor, and all six complete gold assignments are feasible under the decoded modality/presence/nonoverlap/top8 constraints.

Raw and joint decoding still select the fixed shorter conditions competitor in all six donor case records. Candidate inclusion is therefore not the observed bottleneck for these six records; this does not establish the efficacy of any training loss or a modified decoder.
